name: Process Definition Service
purpose: Manages process definition artifacts including schemas, business rules, validation configuration, UI bundle metadata, and label configuration. Provides controlled publication and update of process definitions for downstream platform use.

internal_components.name: Process Definition API
internal_components.responsibility: Exposes endpoints to create, update, retrieve, version, validate, and publish process definitions and their related configuration artifacts.

internal_components.name: Process Definition Application Service
internal_components.responsibility: Coordinates use cases for draft management, versioning, publication workflows, artifact retrieval, and event emission.

internal_components.name: Process Definition Domain Service
internal_components.responsibility: Enforces domain rules for schema consistency, version transitions, publication eligibility, and integrity between schema, rules, validation config, UI bundle metadata, and labels.

internal_components.name: Process Definition Repository
internal_components.responsibility: Persists and retrieves process definition aggregates, versions, and associated configuration artifacts from owned data stores.

internal_components.name: Process Definition Event Publisher
internal_components.responsibility: Publishes process schema lifecycle events when a definition is first published or subsequently updated.

security_controls: Role-based access control restricting create, update, publish, and read operations according to administrative and consumer permissions.
Authentication enforcement for all service APIs using enterprise identity mechanisms.
Audit logging of create, update, publish, and version management actions with actor, timestamp, and changed artifact references.
Input validation and schema payload validation to prevent malformed or unauthorized definition changes.
Encryption in transit for APIs and messaging interactions, and encryption at rest for persisted definition artifacts.
observability: Structured application logs for API requests, validation failures, publication actions, and event publishing outcomes.
Metrics for definition create/update/publish counts, validation error rates, API latency, repository performance, and event publication success/failure.
Distributed tracing across API, application, persistence, and messaging components for definition management and publication flows.
Audit-oriented monitoring dashboards for publication activity and version change history.
service_purpose: Manages process definition artifacts including schemas, business rules, validation configuration, UI bundle metadata, and label configuration. Provides controlled publication and update of process definitions for downstream platform use.
